evals.prompt: Use beads to pick the next unblocked task, log a newly discovered bug blocking it, and claim work safely.
evals.expected_outcome: Runs preflight, uses bd ready --json, bd create --json, bd dep add, and bd update --claim --json.
assertions: Creates child/blocker issue before adding dependency edge

evals.prompt: I want to track my own beads task graph in an open-source repository without committing .beads/ files to upstream PRs.
evals.expected_outcome: Recommends bd init --stealth (or --contributor for fork workflows) and warns against pushing .beads/ upstream.
assertions: Explains keeping tracker files out of upstream PR diffs

evals.prompt: Generate a product constitution, specification, and implementation plan from scratch using /speckit.specify.
evals.expected_outcome: Routes out to spec-kit instead of beads.
